feedback: I want to add more flare and perspective in the game, like right now its just flat but in the original beamrider game, the enemies were coming in from the horizon, and when they died there was a nice subtle animation to it, can you add all of that?

selection.reason: Changing the game from a flat 2D perspective to a pseudo-3D perspective requires a complete overhaul of the coordinate system, movement logic, and drawing routines for the grid, player, enemies, and projectiles. Adding death animations also requires new particle systems and state management. A rewrite is safest for these coordinated changes.
